blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: procedure — Subroutine that does not return a result
parameter — Named input to a subroutine
argument — Value passed in a call
return — Sends a value to the caller

blocks.title: Explain the important decision
blocks.text: The argument is copied into a local parameter. return sends a computed value to the caller; it does not itself print the value.

blocks.title: Worked example · Return a computed value
blocks.text: static int Double(int value) { return value * 2; } int result = Double(6); Console.WriteLine(result);

blocks.title: Worked example · Pass the argument
blocks.text: Double(6) starts a call with local parameter value=6. The caller waits for an integer result.

blocks.title: Worked example · Calculate and return
blocks.text: value*2 evaluates to 12. return 12 ends this call and supplies that integer to the caller.
